title: SearchEventsRequest
description: Request schema for the search_events tool.

startDateFrom.description: Optional lower bound filter. Includes events starting on or after this date/time. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

startDateTo.description: Optional upper bound filter. Includes events starting on or before this date/time. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

places.description: Optional list of SPECIFIC VENUES — a theatre, hall, club, museum, or a room or stage within one. Either a list of venue labels (e.g. "Minotaure") or a list of Artsdata URIs (e.g. "http://kg.artsdata.ca/resource/K5-69"); labels and URIs cannot be mixed in the same call, and a mixed list returns no results. Do NOT pass a city, province, region or country name (e.g. "Toronto", "Québec", "Canada"): municipalities are not part of the Artsdata place hierarchy, so such a value always returns zero results — it is not a sign that no events exist. To find events in a city, either resolve venues in that city with search_entities and pass those, or use sparql_query filtering on schema:location/schema:address/schema:addressLocality. Prefer URIs over labels: a URI also matches events at venues contained within that place (halls, stages, rooms), which a label does not; resolve a venue name to its URI with search_entities (types: ["Place"]). Labels are matched exactly and are case- and accent-sensitive. Can be empty.

artists.description: Optional list of artists; either a list of artist labels (e.g. "Jane Watson") or a list of Artsdata URIs (e.g. "http://kg.artsdata.ca/resource/K2-6574"); labels and URIs cannot be mixed in the same call, and a mixed list returns no results. Resolve a name to its URI with search_entities (types: ["Person"]). Can be empty.

organizations.description: Optional list of organizations. Either a list of organization labels (e.g. "Place Bell") or a list of Artsdata URIs (e.g. "http://kg.artsdata.ca/resource/K5-72"); labels and URIs cannot be mixed in the same call, and a mixed list returns no results. Resolve a name to its URI with search_entities (types: ["Organization"]). Can be empty.

types.description: Optional list of event type labels, e.g. "MusicPerformance", "TheatrePerformance", "ComedyPerformance", "PerformingArtsEvent". Can be empty.

language.description: Language for the labels in the response (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); default is 'en'. This selects the output language only — it does NOT filter events by the language they are performed in.
